messages:
Maya (Content): Quick draft for the launch blog ready. Included a benchmark line and webinar CTA. Need fast passes: legal on claim phrasing, demand-gen on signup flow, growth on headline variants, ops on publish timing. Can you review by EOD?
Omar (Product): Paste the benchmark sentence so I can confirm baseline. Also note hardware used.
Maya (Content): Draft: "In our tests, Redwood Inference reduced per-token serving cost by up to 42% versus a stock PyTorch FP16 runtime on 8k-context workloads; see methodology for details." Hero CTA: "See demo + register for webinar".
Lina (Legal): Prefer "in our tests" (good). Please link to the runbook and include hardware/commands in an appendix. Avoid bare "up to" without method.
Ben (Demand Gen): For gating: gate slides, make recording public later. HS form example I use:
```
formId: "hs_launch_sep2026"
hiddenFields: ["utm_source","utm_campaign","product_interest","company_size"]
redirect: "/thanks/launch-slides"
```
Aria (Growth): Headline A/B: (A) "Lower inference cost, predictable latency" vs (B) "Production-ready LLM inference". Add CTA UTM: ?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=launch_sep.
Sam (Ops): Proposed publish Thu 2026-09-15 09:00 PT, partner embargo 08:30 PT. I can run the HS form test Wed 16:00 PT. Need final permalink and OG image.
Maya (Content): Timeline: lock copy Wed EOD; legal signoff Thu morning; demand-gen builds form Thu afternoon; ops preflight Wed. Permalink suggestion: /blog/redwood-inference-launch-2026.
Lina (Legal): I can sign off if the runbook link and appendix are present on the draft page. Replace absolute quality claims with "comparable automated-eval metrics (see methodology)".
Ben (Demand Gen): Modal copy: "Get the benchmark slides + ops checklist". Will QA after Ops test.
Aria (Growth): Confirmed A/B. I'll upload variants to CMS once copy is locked.
Sam (Ops): HS form staging test scheduled Wed 16:00 PT; I'll post results. publish-bot: Publish job queued: 2026-09-15T09:00:00-07:00 (blog/redwood-inference-launch-2026).
Maya (Content): Thanks everyone 680 Please react when your item is done.
